 Print BSF HC RO RM answer key 2026 out The Border Security Force ( BSF ) has released the Head Constable (Radio Operator and Radio Mechanic) answer key 2026. Candidates who appeared for the Computer-Based Test (CBT) conducted on November 2 can now check their provisional answer keys and response sheets through the official recruitment website, rectt.bsf.gov.in. The answer key will help candidates compare their responses with the answers provided by the examination authority and calculate their expected marks. Candidates will have to log in using their roll number and password to access the answer key and response sheet. The recruitment examination is being conducted to fill 1,121 vacancies, including 910 posts for Head Constable (Radio Operator) and 211 posts for Head Constable (Radio Mechanic). BSF Head Constable answer key 2026 : How to download
 Candidates can follow these steps to download their answer keys and response sheets: Visit the official website, rectt.bsf.gov.in.
 Open the recruitment section on the homepage.
 Click on the BSF Head Constable RO/RM answer key 2026 link.
 Select the relevant post, Radio Operator or Radio Mechanic.
 Enter your roll number and password.
 Submit the login details.
 The answer key and response sheet will appear on the screen.
 Check your responses and download the documents for future reference.
 Direct link here. BSF Head Constable answer key 2026: How to raise objections
 Candidates who are not satisfied with any answer mentioned in the provisional answer key can submit objections through the official recruitment portal. To challenge an answer, candidates need to log in to the portal using their credentials and select the question they want to challenge. They should provide the correct answer along with a supporting explanation and relevant documents, wherever required. The objection facility will remain available until November 6, 2026, at 11:55 pm. Candidates should submit their challenges within the given deadline, as objections received after the closing time will not be considered.
